readings: For each trader type (trader.tradekind), count the advanced behaviour records (rows in advancedbehavior) whose linked transaction record and that transaction's trader both exist. Give each type's share as its count divided by the total count across all types, unrounded. Several advanced behaviour records for the same transaction each count separately.

For each trader type (trader.tradekind), count the distinct transaction records that have at least one advanced behaviour record and whose trader exists. Give each type's share as its distinct-transaction count divided by the total distinct-transaction count across all types, unrounded. A transaction with several advanced behaviour records counts once.
queries:
SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
FROM advancedbehavior a
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg
JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
GROUP BY t.tradekind

WITH t AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT tr.transreg, td.tradekind
  FROM transactionrecord tr
  JOIN trader td ON td.tradereg = tr.trdref
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM advancedbehavior ab WHERE ab.translink = tr.transreg)
)
SELECT tradekind,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
       CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t) AS share
FROM t
GROUP BY tradekind;
